summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repository without running any tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.finished_time field, finished property based on it, _reset clears it, new TimeElapsedColumn between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn, capture logic in Progress.update and advance inside the lock, explicit clear in Progress.reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with in-method imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry); tests/test_palette.py (new test_rich_cast); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns, and expected output regenerated by hand-tracing clock reads). The test_columns expected output is unverified because tests were not run; the derivation was checked by counting bar glyphs (25 and 16) and verifying rendered row widths of 80 cells. Docs were not updated (out of scope).
